headline: Kerch Bridge Struck as Russia Budgets for Permanent War
subheadline: Ukrainian Neptune missiles sever Kerch railway logistics while Moscow allocates 17.1 trillion rubles for 2027 defense spending.
lede: Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck the Kerch Bridge railway arch, halting train movement and severing a critical Russian ammunition artery to the southern front, as Moscow simultaneously unveiled a 2027 budget dedicating 17.1 trillion rubles — a 32% increase — to defense. In the Middle East, Israeli forces pounded Lebanon's eastern Beqaa Valley and 15 southern villages with airstrikes and artillery, while Iranian air defenses engaged in Ahvaz and UAVs launched from Omidiyeh. Iraqi security forces displaced IRGC-aligned Kataib Hezbollah from Jurf al-Sakhar, installing PMF Brigades 72 and 79 in a strategic command restructuring. Western assessments now indicate a rising probability of major U.S. military action against Iran.

sections.title: Kerch Bridge Hit, Russia Militarizes Budget
sections.body: Russian Geran-5 and Shahed drones struck the Burshtyn thermal power plant and Kyiv infrastructure across five regions, killing one in Bucha district and injuring at least four in Kyiv. Ukrainian forces responded with a precision Neptune missile strike on the Kerch Bridge railway section, stopping train movement and disrupting ammunition supply lines to the southern front. Russia's 2027 federal budget allocates 17.1 trillion rubles to national defense — 35% of total expenditures — while cutting health and social spending. The U.K. and Norway pledged over £100 million for two strike boats to bolster Ukrainian naval defense of Black Sea grain corridors.

sections.title: Israel Strikes Beqaa, Iraq Purges IRGC Proxies
sections.body: Israeli airstrikes hit the al-Sha'ra area in the eastern Beqaa Valley while artillery shelled 15 southern Lebanese villages including Doha Kfar Reman and Zoutr al-Sharqiyah, generating 16 shelling alerts among 115 total warnings that included 57 drone sightings. Iranian military aviation surged with UAV launches from Omidiyeh Fifth Tactical Air Base, jet operations in Isfahan and Khuzestan, and air defense activation in Ahvaz. Iraqi security forces announced the withdrawal of Kataib Hezbollah from Jurf al-Sakhar, replacing the IRGC-aligned militia with PMF Brigades 72 and 79, while Kataib Hezbollah relocated to al-Qaim. Western officials assess a rising probability of major U.S. military action against Iran amid Israeli pressure for a sustained campaign.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous Ukrainian strike on the Kerch Bridge logistics artery and Russia's 32% defense budget increase signal a hardening of both sides' long-term war postures. In the Middle East, Israeli multi-axis strikes on Lebanon, Iranian air operations across three provinces, and Iraqi state displacement of IRGC proxies from strategic terrain indicate a coordinated pressure campaign narrowing diplomatic space. The convergence of Western strike assessments on Iran with explicit Israeli leadership timelines suggests an escalation window measured in days.
